scope: Targeted recovery of one omitted printed table leaf and its printer colophon, plus title-page, end-formula, and specifically requested blank-verso checks. This is not a full facsimile collation.

edition_match.assessment: Both independently inspected title pages match the PG bibliographical edition: volume V, Broglie, Paris, Calmann Lévy, 1892.
limitations: The exact physical BnF copy used by PG has not been inspected in this pass.
No claim is made that all pages or all textual details are identical between the witnesses and PG.

pg_omission_verification.method: Case-folded whitespace-normalized searches of the four saved official PG HTML/text variants, plus inspection of their endings.
pg_omission_verification.assessment: The table heading and printer colophon are absent from all four checked PG variants. Corresponding section titles elsewhere in PG do not preserve the omitted printed table as a unit.
pg_omission_verification.pg_end_formula_source: The existing PG ending is original printed paratext, independently visible on printed p. 650, preceding the omitted table leaf.

transcription_policy: Word content, accents, date ranges, and target page references are preserved.
All small capitals are represented as ordinary Unicode uppercase; type size, letterspacing, and font differences are not encoded in text.
Dot leaders and column space are represented by a tab between label and target page, rather than an invented number of dots.
The line-break hyphen in MEN-TIONNÉS is removed when the index entry is joined.
The table says DANS LES « MÉMOIRES », unlike the index body heading DANS CES MÉMOIRES; preserve the table wording.
The table entries do not contain Suite; do not insert that word from the body headings.
Target page I is Roman; it is not Arabic 1.
Printer code is preserved literally without interpreting its meaning.
